text:
mia: SignalPath (SI) requested an observability bundle for Datadog listing: OTLP->Datadog mapping, dashboard JSON, monitor templates, packaging. 2-week target. Who can own what?

alex: I'll own OTLP mapping + transform. Need SignalPath alert schema and PII rules.

jordan: I'll build dashboards + marketplace copy. Will include example monitor queries.

samir: I'll handle packaging: OCI+terraform for marketplace, helm + KMS guide for private. Need tracer SDK matrix and export endpoints.

claudia: I'll set the partner kickoff; Thu 10am PT ok?

mia: Works. SignalPath schema: model_id, request_id, latency_ms, error_type, user_prompt, user_id, env, severity. They want model_id & request_id in spans. Retention short=30d, long=365d.

alex: Prototype transform: redact user_prompt if pii=true; hash user_id; set dd.alert.priority when latency_ms>500. Will PR by Fri.

jordan: Bundle proposal: dashboard JSON, monitor templates (latency/error), onboarding runbook, terraform example. OCI manifest for marketplace.

samir: Test matrix: Hosted, Dedicated (reserved GPUs), Private VPC. Checklist: VPN route, firewall rules, KMS keys, tracer versions.

ops-bot: Preflight: infra-lint passed, dashboard-schema-check queued.

mia: Owners: alex (mapping), jordan (dashboards), samir (packaging), claudia (partner comms). Follow-up after kickoff. :calendar:
